task: Binary classification - probability of diabetes onset

training_data.population: Female patients of Pima Indian heritage, at least 21 years old

intended_use: Educational demonstration of a recall-first screening triage. It ranks patients for a confirmatory blood test; it is a prioritisation aid, not a diagnosis.
out_of_scope_uses: Any real clinical diagnosis or treatment decision
Insurance pricing, employment screening or eligibility decisions
Populations unlike the training cohort (men, under-21s, other ancestries)

operating_point.rule: maximise recall subject to precision >= 0.50; cost model FN=5 x FP=1

ethical_considerations.false_negative_harm: A missed case is told they are healthy and exits the screening funnel; harm compounds silently over years. This is why the threshold is tuned for recall and why the model must never be the last check.
ethical_considerations.false_positive_harm: Anxiety plus one confirmatory test. Real but recoverable - which is why we accept more of them.
ethical_considerations.representation: A single-ancestry, female-only cohort. Applying this model to any other population is extrapolation, not prediction.
ethical_considerations.automation_bias: A clinician who sees 'low risk' may stop looking. The UI therefore shows a probability with its uncertainty, never a bare 'negative'.
ethical_considerations.data_provenance: The impossible zeros prove the source data was silently corrupted. Any deployment needs the same audit on its own intake pipeline.

limitations: Only 768 patients - confidence intervals are wide
Insulin missing in 48.7% of rows; its imputed values are weakly informed
Cross-sectional data: the model predicts a label, not a time-to-onset
No external validation cohort; at Indian prevalence (ICMR-INDIAB 11.4%) precision at this threshold falls to about 21%, so the cut-off must be re-tuned before any use in India
Synthetic augmentation (CTGAN / TVAE / SMOTE) did not beat class weighting on 214 diabetic training patients, so the deployed model is trained on real patients only

generative_components.llm_explanations: Patient-facing summaries are written by an LLM from SHAP values and clinical reference bands only; a fixed clinician-review disclaimer is appended server-side and a deterministic template is used whenever the LLM is unavailable.
generative_components.synthetic_data: CTGAN, TVAE and Gaussian Copula benchmarked against SMOTE and no augmentation.

monitoring_plan: Track realised recall against confirmed follow-up results every quarter
Alert on feature drift (mean glucose, BMI) versus the training distribution
Re-tune the threshold if prevalence shifts - the cut-off is prevalence-dependent
